name: velvet
description: Keep a Velvet work log from your coding agent with the velvet CLI: log progress, file and update tickets, plan sprints, attach evidence and images, and recap your week.

interface.shortDescription: Your work log, kept by your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Velvet records what work actually happened. This plugin teaches the agent to use the velvet CLI: when and where to log progress, how to file and update tickets, how to plan sprints and milestones, and how to attach pull requests, commits, and images as evidence.
defaultPrompt: Log what I just finished to Velvet.
What have I worked on this week?
File a Velvet ticket for this bug.
